text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused primarily on assessing impacts of future land use scenarios on butterfly species distributions in Switzerland. Although it uses four future land use scenarios, the primary research objective is ecological—modeling species occurrence responses to these scenarios—rather than developing or predicting land use/land cover (LULC) changes themselves. The LULC scenarios are derived from previous work and used as inputs; the paper does not present primary spatial LULC prediction or simulation with quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC maps as a central research question. The spatial implementation of scenarios is at the commune level within Switzerland (national scale), but the study’s core focus is species distribution modeling under given LULC scenarios, not on LULC prediction per se. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion requiring primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation.)
